title: Responsive density and key interaction layouts — wireframes & grooming notes
content:
Context:
Small working session notes + groom for component-level decisions on how density modes (comfortable / compact / dense) should behave across breakpoints in the Console. This is a working doc — see linked artifacts for initial spec and prototype PR. Goal: make a concrete set of wireframe prescriptions and accessible interaction rules we can land as a small DS change set (v-next).

Summary of decisions we're trying to reach:
- Define three density profiles and the exact token sizes, paddings, and min touch targets per profile.
- Constrain layout changes so keyboard navigation order and landmarks remain stable across densities.
- Provide patterns for collapsing side panels and persistent controls for small widths without breaking screen reader flow.
- Decide microinteraction timing for state transitions (expand/collapse, hover->focus, error reveal) to balance discoverability and motion-sickness accessibility.

Quick reference (draft values):
- Comfortable: 16px base font, 12–16px vertical padding on list items, min touch target 44x44px.
- Compact: 14px base font, 8–12px vertical padding, min touch target 40x40px.
- Dense: 13px base font, 6–8px padding, min touch target still 36x36px *only for mouse/keyboard*; when touch device detected, force to Compact.

Why: We want to avoid tiny actionable targets on tablets/phones; dense mode is primarily for desktop power users. Explicit detection of input modality recommended (pointer coarse vs fine) to prevent inaccessible small targets on touch devices.

Wireframe notes by breakpoint:
- Desktop (>=1200px):
  - Two-column main area: left nav (collapsible, persistent aria-controls), content panel.
  - Density switch lives in user menu and as a per-route override (small badge on route header).
  - When switching density, do not re-order DOM elements; only adjust spacing/CSS variables to preserve focus order.
  - Collapsible panel animation: height transition 200ms ease-out; reduced-motion: instant toggle.

- Tablet (768–1199px):
  - Side nav collapses to icon-only mode by default in Compact/Dense.
  - Primary action buttons move from header to sticky footer toolbar when vertical height < 540px.
  - Keyboard users: sticky toolbar must be reachable via logical tab order and announced as "Action toolbar" with role="region" and aria-label.

- Mobile (<768px):
  - Single column stack.
  - Persistent header: condensed to show only route title + hamburger + overflow CTA.
  - Actions: use sheet / bottom drawer for multi-action flows (accessible focus trap) rather than inline buttons that push content.
  - Dense mode ignored on small screens (fallback to Compact).

Accessibility-specific rules (A11y):
- ARIA & Landmarks:
  - Keep main, nav, complementary landmarks stable across densities. If an element changes visual position, do not remove/recreate from DOM — only move with CSS transforms when possible.
  - Collapsed panels should maintain aria-expanded on the trigger and aria-controls pointing to the panel id.

- Keyboard navigation:
  - Tab order must follow DOM reading order. If sticky footers/toolbars are injected visually, ensure they are placed after main content in DOM but made visible with position:sticky; otherwise keyboard users will hit them too early.
  - Shortcuts: density toggle mapped to Alt+D (desktop) as an optional convenience; must be documented in keyboard shortcuts modal.

- Focus visibility:
  - Strong focus ring required for Compact/Dense (thicker ring, slightly larger offset) because reduced spacing can cause focus trap.
  - Do not rely solely on color to indicate focus.

- Touch targets:
  - If pointer:coarse => override density to at least Compact and ensure 44px min target for primary actions.

Microinteraction & motion guidelines:
- Expand/collapse: default 200ms; reduced-motion: 0ms.
- Hover -> reveal controls: delay 120ms to avoid accidental reveals during fast mouse moves; keyboard focus should reveal immediately.
- Error crossfade (inline validation): 160ms with transformY -4px motion; reduced-motion: show immediately.

Edge cases & gotchas (notes from the session):
- Problem: In Dense mode the list item action affordance (three-dot menu) overlaps with right-aligned timestamp on narrow tables. Proposal: move action menu into trailing column with dedicated min width and add ellipsifying rule for timestamp.
- Problem: Mobile landscape + dense headers caused header overflow. Fix: collapse header meta into overflow menu when available width < 420px.
- Problem: Screen reader reading order sometimes reads floating toast notices before the main content if DOM append order is inconsistent. Rule: append toasts to a dedicated aria-live region placed at end of app wrapper; use polite for non-blocking messages, assertive only for urgent errors.

Wireframe sketches (textual):
- Desktop / Comfortable / page list:
  [LeftNav (icons + label)] | [Header: title | search | density switch | actions]
  [FilterRow]
  [Table or CardGrid]

- Tablet / Compact / detail view:
  [LeftNav: icons] | [Header reduced]
  [Content column]
  [Sticky action toolbar at bottom - contains Save, Run, Overflow]

- Mobile / Compact / edit flow:
  [Condensed header]
  [Form fields stacked]
  [Floating CTA (bottom-right) => opens Action sheet on tap]

Backlog grooming notes (prioritized):
- P1 (sprint 12): enforce pointer detection and fallback to Compact on touch (UX-329). Owner: Marcus.
- P1: implement aria-live container refactor for toasts (RDW-4217). Owner: Emily.
- P2: add a density toggle in user preferences + per-route override (requires server save + client flagging). Owner: Sofia.
- P3: update DS tokens for Compact/Dense to include focus offsets & ring thickness; create migration notes for component owners. Owner: Ravi.
- P3: wireframe and QA checklist for sticky toolbars to ensure keyboard reachability. Owner: Jordan.

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Should Dense ever drop min touch below 36px on laptop touchscreens? (security: no) -> proposal: never below 36px and force to Compact for coarse pointers.
- Do we allow per-route density overrides to persist across devices? (privacy + sync concerns) -> tentative: store as user preference but allow session override without sync. Need PM input.
- How aggressive should visual compression be for table rows? Compress font, padding, and row-gap vs. hide secondary metadata. Which do we prefer by default? Recommendation: hide secondary metadata in Dense, compress in Compact.

QA checklist for handoff:
- [ ] Density toggle works and preserves route scroll position.
- [ ] Keyboard tab order unchanged after density switch.
- [ ] ARIA attributes present for collapsible panels and action toolbars.
- [ ] Toasts announced in correct order and do not steal focus.
- [ ] Touch target sizes enforced for pointer:coarse.
- [ ] Reduced-motion respected for all transitions.

Next steps (action items):
- Marcus: implement pointer detection experiment and report regressions by 2026-05-12.
- Emily: draft toast aria-live refactor PR and link to this doc by 2026-05-07.
- Ravi: produce token delta spec (compact/dense) with example components (list, table, form) by 2026-05-14.
- Sofia: collect PM decision on persistence of density overrides and update this doc.

Notes to self (messy):
- Consider adding small "hint" pill near density toggle that shows what mode does (tooltip with example). Might help non-power users understand why things shrink.
- Investigate keyboard shortcut conflicts with browser and OS — register shortcuts only on focused app and surface in shortcut modal.
- Add one-off test plan for screen reader (NVDA + VoiceOver) and mobile talkback to validate toolbar and sheet behaviours.

Meeting log snippets:
- 2026-03-02 workshop: strong preference for keeping DOM stable. Everyone agreed transformed moves only.
- 2026-04-21 follow-up: PM requests per-route override; flagged for privacy review.

If you see anything missing or want another wireframe variant, drop a note here or ping in #ux-console.

-- end --
